_original_lore: Can be combined with an Aspect of
the Leech in a Crafting Table to
increase its range from 4 blocks to
5 blocks and decrease its Mana Cost
name: 超级血蛭修正器

source: Can be combined with an Aspect of
the Leech in a Crafting Table to
increase its range from {{N0}} blocks to
{{N1}} blocks and decrease its Mana Cost
loreParagraphs.translation: 可在工作台中与血蛭之刃结合,将其范围从 {{N0}} 格提升至 {{N1}} 格,并将其法力消耗从 {{N2}} 降低至 {{N3}}.
